evidence.sentence: What started as supplying skilled people to the Channel Tunnel project in 1988 has grown into the UK's leading secondment provider. (page title: Technical Engineering Services & Secondment Company)
We employ more than 850 people, working on projects across the UK, improving the country's infrastructure and leaving a legacy to be proud of.
